ar.tourColumnsBody: Drag the line between two headings to resize a column, or drag a heading to move it. Narrow {switches} or {modes} to show fewer of its buttons, and widen it to show more.
ar.tourColumnTogglesBody: The first three buttons hide the {switches}, {modes} and {parent} columns entirely. Press again to bring its column back.
ar.tourEffectControlsBody: The selected layer's effects are listed here, in the order they are applied. Drag an effect's heading to move it, and click a parameter's stopwatch to animate it.
ar.tourEffectMenusBody: {add} lists every effect by category. Right-click an effect's heading to rename, move, copy or remove it.
ar.tourEffectsBody: Double-click an effect to add it to the selected layers, or drag it onto a layer. {shortcut} finds an effect from anywhere.
ar.tourEffectsBodyNoShortcut: Double-click an effect to add it to the selected layers, or drag it onto a layer.
ar.tourGraphBody: {graph} shows curves in place of the layer bars. It draws the properties you have selected.
ar.tourLayersBody: Each layer in the composition has a row here. Click a row to select its layer.
ar.tourNodeGraphBody: The {workspace} workspace draws the selected layer's effects as boxes joined by wires. Drop a box onto a wire to insert it there, and drag a wire off a box to bypass it.
ar.tourNodePanelBody: Click a box and its parameters are listed here, a driver's included. An effect's rows are the same ones {effectControls} shows.
ar.tourNodeSearchBody: {shortcut}, or a right-click on the canvas, opens this search for an effect or a driver to add. A driver makes a value, and a wire from one into a parameter drives it.
ar.tourNodeSearchBodyClick: A right-click on the canvas opens this search for an effect or a driver to add. A driver makes a value, and a wire from one into a parameter drives it.
ar.tourNodeSearchBodyKey: {shortcut} over the canvas opens this search for an effect or a driver to add. A driver makes a value, and a wire from one into a parameter drives it.
ar.tourProjectBody: Everything in the project is listed here. Import footage with the button at the bottom, double-clicking, or drop files onto the panel.
ar.tourPropertiesBody: The arrow beside a layer opens its properties, as it has here. Click a property's stopwatch, like this one, to start animating it.
ar.tourToolsBody: Click a tool to pick it. A tool with a mark in its corner has more behind it. Accessed by right-clicking or holding the button.
ar.tourViewerBody: The frame at the playhead is shown here. The menus round it set the zoom, the preview quality and how colour is displayed.
ar.tourWorkspacesBody: Each name is a panel layout for a different job. {shortcut} opens the command palette, which finds any command.
ar.tourWorkspacesBodyNoShortcut: Each name is a panel layout for a different job.

de.tourColumnsBody: Drag the line between two headings to resize a column, or drag a heading to move it. Narrow {switches} or {modes} to show fewer of its buttons, and widen it to show more.
de.tourColumnTogglesBody: The first three buttons hide the {switches}, {modes} and {parent} columns entirely. Press again to bring its column back.
de.tourEffectControlsBody: The selected layer's effects are listed here, in the order they are applied. Drag an effect's heading to move it, and click a parameter's stopwatch to animate it.
de.tourEffectMenusBody: {add} lists every effect by category. Right-click an effect's heading to rename, move, copy or remove it.
de.tourEffectsBody: Double-click an effect to add it to the selected layers, or drag it onto a layer. {shortcut} finds an effect from anywhere.
de.tourEffectsBodyNoShortcut: Double-click an effect to add it to the selected layers, or drag it onto a layer.
de.tourGraphBody: {graph} shows curves in place of the layer bars. It draws the properties you have selected.
de.tourLayersBody: Each layer in the composition has a row here. Click a row to select its layer.
de.tourNodeGraphBody: The {workspace} workspace draws the selected layer's effects as boxes joined by wires. Drop a box onto a wire to insert it there, and drag a wire off a box to bypass it.
de.tourNodePanelBody: Click a box and its parameters are listed here, a driver's included. An effect's rows are the same ones {effectControls} shows.
de.tourNodeSearchBody: {shortcut}, or a right-click on the canvas, opens this search for an effect or a driver to add. A driver makes a value, and a wire from one into a parameter drives it.
de.tourNodeSearchBodyClick: A right-click on the canvas opens this search for an effect or a driver to add. A driver makes a value, and a wire from one into a parameter drives it.
de.tourNodeSearchBodyKey: {shortcut} over the canvas opens this search for an effect or a driver to add. A driver makes a value, and a wire from one into a parameter drives it.
de.tourProjectBody: Everything in the project is listed here. Import footage with the button at the bottom, double-clicking, or drop files onto the panel.
de.tourPropertiesBody: The arrow beside a layer opens its properties, as it has here. Click a property's stopwatch, like this one, to start animating it.
de.tourToolsBody: Click a tool to pick it. A tool with a mark in its corner has more behind it. Accessed by right-clicking or holding the button.
de.tourViewerBody: The frame at the playhead is shown here. The menus round it set the zoom, the preview quality and how colour is displayed.
de.tourWorkspacesBody: Each name is a panel layout for a different job. {shortcut} opens the command palette, which finds any command.
de.tourWorkspacesBodyNoShortcut: Each name is a panel layout for a different job.

es.tourColumnsBody: Drag the line between two headings to resize a column, or drag a heading to move it. Narrow {switches} or {modes} to show fewer of its buttons, and widen it to show more.
es.tourColumnTogglesBody: The first three buttons hide the {switches}, {modes} and {parent} columns entirely. Press again to bring its column back.
es.tourEffectControlsBody: The selected layer's effects are listed here, in the order they are applied. Drag an effect's heading to move it, and click a parameter's stopwatch to animate it.
es.tourEffectMenusBody: {add} lists every effect by category. Right-click an effect's heading to rename, move, copy or remove it.
es.tourEffectsBody: Double-click an effect to add it to the selected layers, or drag it onto a layer. {shortcut} finds an effect from anywhere.
es.tourEffectsBodyNoShortcut: Double-click an effect to add it to the selected layers, or drag it onto a layer.
es.tourGraphBody: {graph} shows curves in place of the layer bars. It draws the properties you have selected.
es.tourLayersBody: Each layer in the composition has a row here. Click a row to select its layer.
es.tourNodeGraphBody: The {workspace} workspace draws the selected layer's effects as boxes joined by wires. Drop a box onto a wire to insert it there, and drag a wire off a box to bypass it.
es.tourNodePanelBody: Click a box and its parameters are listed here, a driver's included. An effect's rows are the same ones {effectControls} shows.
es.tourNodeSearchBody: {shortcut}, or a right-click on the canvas, opens this search for an effect or a driver to add. A driver makes a value, and a wire from one into a parameter drives it.
es.tourNodeSearchBodyClick: A right-click on the canvas opens this search for an effect or a driver to add. A driver makes a value, and a wire from one into a parameter drives it.
es.tourNodeSearchBodyKey: {shortcut} over the canvas opens this search for an effect or a driver to add. A driver makes a value, and a wire from one into a parameter drives it.
es.tourProjectBody: Everything in the project is listed here. Import footage with the button at the bottom, double-clicking, or drop files onto the panel.
es.tourPropertiesBody: The arrow beside a layer opens its properties, as it has here. Click a property's stopwatch, like this one, to start animating it.
es.tourToolsBody: Click a tool to pick it. A tool with a mark in its corner has more behind it. Accessed by right-clicking or holding the button.
es.tourViewerBody: The frame at the playhead is shown here. The menus round it set the zoom, the preview quality and how colour is displayed.
es.tourWorkspacesBody: Each name is a panel layout for a different job. {shortcut} opens the command palette, which finds any command.
es.tourWorkspacesBodyNoShortcut: Each name is a panel layout for a different job.

it.tourColumnsBody: Drag the line between two headings to resize a column, or drag a heading to move it. Narrow {switches} or {modes} to show fewer of its buttons, and widen it to show more.
it.tourColumnTogglesBody: The first three buttons hide the {switches}, {modes} and {parent} columns entirely. Press again to bring its column back.
it.tourEffectControlsBody: The selected layer's effects are listed here, in the order they are applied. Drag an effect's heading to move it, and click a parameter's stopwatch to animate it.
it.tourEffectMenusBody: {add} lists every effect by category. Right-click an effect's heading to rename, move, copy or remove it.
it.tourEffectsBody: Double-click an effect to add it to the selected layers, or drag it onto a layer. {shortcut} finds an effect from anywhere.
it.tourEffectsBodyNoShortcut: Double-click an effect to add it to the selected layers, or drag it onto a layer.
it.tourGraphBody: {graph} shows curves in place of the layer bars. It draws the properties you have selected.
it.tourLayersBody: Each layer in the composition has a row here. Click a row to select its layer.
it.tourNodeGraphBody: The {workspace} workspace draws the selected layer's effects as boxes joined by wires. Drop a box onto a wire to insert it there, and drag a wire off a box to bypass it.
it.tourNodePanelBody: Click a box and its parameters are listed here, a driver's included. An effect's rows are the same ones {effectControls} shows.
it.tourNodeSearchBody: {shortcut}, or a right-click on the canvas, opens this search for an effect or a driver to add. A driver makes a value, and a wire from one into a parameter drives it.
it.tourNodeSearchBodyClick: A right-click on the canvas opens this search for an effect or a driver to add. A driver makes a value, and a wire from one into a parameter drives it.
it.tourNodeSearchBodyKey: {shortcut} over the canvas opens this search for an effect or a driver to add. A driver makes a value, and a wire from one into a parameter drives it.
it.tourProjectBody: Everything in the project is listed here. Import footage with the button at the bottom, double-clicking, or drop files onto the panel.
it.tourPropertiesBody: The arrow beside a layer opens its properties, as it has here. Click a property's stopwatch, like this one, to start animating it.
it.tourViewerBody: The frame at the playhead is shown here. The menus round it set the zoom, the preview quality and how colour is displayed.
it.tourWorkspacesBody: Each name is a panel layout for a different job. {shortcut} opens the command palette, which finds any command.

pl.tourEffectControlsBody: The selected layer's effects are listed here, in the order they are applied. Drag an effect's heading to move it, and click a parameter's stopwatch to animate it.

pl.tourNodeGraphBody: The {workspace} workspace draws the selected layer's effects as boxes joined by wires. Drop a box onto a wire to insert it there, and drag a wire off a box to bypass it.
pl.tourNodePanelBody: Click a box and its parameters are listed here, a driver's included. An effect's rows are the same ones {effectControls} shows.
pl.tourNodeSearchBody: {shortcut}, or a right-click on the canvas, opens this search for an effect or a driver to add. A driver makes a value, and a wire from one into a parameter drives it.

pl.tourPropertiesBody: The arrow beside a layer opens its properties, as it has here. Click a property's stopwatch, like this one, to start animating it.
pl.tourViewerBody: The frame at the playhead is shown here. The menus round it set the zoom, the preview quality and how colour is displayed.

pt.tourColumnsBody: Drag the line between two headings to resize a column, or drag a heading to move it. Narrow {switches} or {modes} to show fewer of its buttons, and widen it to show more.
pt.tourColumnTogglesBody: The first three buttons hide the {switches}, {modes} and {parent} columns entirely. Press again to bring its column back.
pt.tourEffectControlsBody: The selected layer's effects are listed here, in the order they are applied. Drag an effect's heading to move it, and click a parameter's stopwatch to animate it.
pt.tourEffectMenusBody: {add} lists every effect by category. Right-click an effect's heading to rename, move, copy or remove it.
pt.tourEffectsBody: Double-click an effect to add it to the selected layers, or drag it onto a layer. {shortcut} finds an effect from anywhere.
pt.tourEffectsBodyNoShortcut: Double-click an effect to add it to the selected layers, or drag it onto a layer.
pt.tourGraphBody: {graph} shows curves in place of the layer bars. It draws the properties you have selected.
pt.tourLayersBody: Each layer in the composition has a row here. Click a row to select its layer.
pt.tourNodeGraphBody: The {workspace} workspace draws the selected layer's effects as boxes joined by wires. Drop a box onto a wire to insert it there, and drag a wire off a box to bypass it.
pt.tourNodePanelBody: Click a box and its parameters are listed here, a driver's included. An effect's rows are the same ones {effectControls} shows.
pt.tourNodeSearchBody: {shortcut}, or a right-click on the canvas, opens this search for an effect or a driver to add. A driver makes a value, and a wire from one into a parameter drives it.
pt.tourNodeSearchBodyClick: A right-click on the canvas opens this search for an effect or a driver to add. A driver makes a value, and a wire from one into a parameter drives it.
pt.tourNodeSearchBodyKey: {shortcut} over the canvas opens this search for an effect or a driver to add. A driver makes a value, and a wire from one into a parameter drives it.
pt.tourProjectBody: Everything in the project is listed here. Import footage with the button at the bottom, double-clicking, or drop files onto the panel.
pt.tourPropertiesBody: The arrow beside a layer opens its properties, as it has here. Click a property's stopwatch, like this one, to start animating it.
pt.tourToolsBody: Click a tool to pick it. A tool with a mark in its corner has more behind it. Accessed by right-clicking or holding the button.
pt.tourViewerBody: The frame at the playhead is shown here. The menus round it set the zoom, the preview quality and how colour is displayed.
pt.tourWorkspacesBody: Each name is a panel layout for a different job. {shortcut} opens the command palette, which finds any command.
pt.tourWorkspacesBodyNoShortcut: Each name is a panel layout for a different job.
